;Law and crime
*Aftermath of the [[Charlottesville car attack]]
**James A. Fields Jr. receives a second life sentence in prison plus 419 years for driving his car into a crowd of protestors, killing one and injuring 28, at the 2017 [[Unite the Right rally]] in [[Charlottesville, Virginia]]. [https://apnews.com/article/08c7dbeb08ef4ad5874cd719e7cfc6b3 (AP)]
*A police raid on a [[Neo-Nazism|neo-Nazi]] group in northern [[Italy]] results in the arrest of three people. Sophisticated weaponry, including a [[Super 530|Matra Super 530F]] air-to-air missile, are seized during the operation. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-48987723 (BBC News)]
